description: Inside a Sales voucher, Ctrl+H opens the unified Change Mode picker (TallyPrime replaced ERP9's Alt+I / Ctrl+V two-axis toggles). The invoice modes are offered but each is marked 'not built': this edition implements SINGLE vs DOUBLE entry (Payment / Receipt / Contra) and not the invoice family, and labelling them is the same honesty the keymap applies to unavailable combos — a key that silently does nothing is what makes a keyboard user distrust the app.
